The '''Central Ocean''' was one of four major bodies of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. It was bordered by the [[Northern Continent]] and [[Southern Wasteland]], and flowed into the [[Triad Sea]].
